Like a tagalong who wandered in by accident.
Is it really fine for me to be here?"
Black Fang kept her gaze forward.
"The feeling is mutual."
Orianna shot her a look.
"Even you?"
"I am currently realm hopping," Black Fang replied, tone flat, as if that alone covered everything.
It did.
Orianna nodded once.
"Right.
After being stuck to Iskaris for four centuries, we leave by diving into the trunk of a tree and end up inside the mind of a man who keeps trying to bone you at any cost."
Black Fang's head turned just enough for a side glance to cut across Orianna, sharp and dangerous.
Orianna did not pull any statements back.
She rolled her shoulders and sighed.
"I was out cold for a short while, yet it feels like I missed centuries."
"I stayed conscious and still feel the same.
This is...
Plain absurd." The Venomborne Terror admitted with a difficult expression.

The quiet pressed in around them.

"Listen to us.
We sound like old women."
Black Fang's mouth twitched and quoted Quinlan, "We are 'ancient ladies,' after all..." Orianna paused where she was.
"He really did say that, didn't he?
The galls on that guy..."
"I thought I understood how this life of mine would go," Orianna went on.
"I thought the road ahead was mapped.
But everything has been turned sideways."
Orianna's steps slowed.
Her gaze drifted ahead, unfocused, then tipped slightly upward as if she were looking past the hills and into an older scene.
"I remember back when he was just a weak rookie trying to win the Vesper Phenom competition.
All elbows and bravado.
Now look at him.
Destroying cities.
Eviscerating battalions.
Dragging people across realms like it is a change of clothes.
All within a few months."
Black Fang's pace did not change.
The corner of her mouth lifted, just barely.
"Back then, he flirted with Vex in public.
Constantly."
Orianna's eyes widened, then lit.
"Oh yeah!
I remember now." She chuckled brightly.
"Future Hubby.
Future Wifey.
They kept calling each other that.
So corny."
She turned her head, grin widening as she studied Black Fang's profile.
"And now he is trying to get into your pants.
A woman with even more emotional baggage by a long mile.
A woman who, once again, can snap his neck." Her grin turned sly.
"I am starting to see a pattern.
That man has a very acquired taste."
Black Fang stopped.
Her head turned fully this time.
The glance that followed carried real weight, sharp enough to make Orianna nearly take on a defensive formation.
"Are you saying," Black Fang asked, voice low and even, "that I do not deserve to be courted?"
Orianna froze for half a breath.
Then she burst out laughing, bending forward as she slapped a hand against Black Fang's shoulder.
"Look at you!
Twisting what I said to fit your agenda.
You are starting to act like a proper woman now.
Congratulations."
Black Fang swiped Orianna's hand away with a short, controlled motion.
A small shadow cut across the pale light.
"Rosie agrees!" a bright voice declared from above.
"Miss Black Fang deserves to be courted!"
Something green and fast dropped from the sky and landed squarely on Black Fang's shoulders with a soft thump.
Small arms wrapped around her head for balance.
"So she should go on romantic dates with Daddy and let him charm her!"
Black Fang stiffened.
Her shoulders drew tight.
One hand lifted, then stopped halfway, fingers curling.
Her jaw set, eyes forward, posture rigid in a way Orianna had only seen before combat.

She could've dodged.
But she trusted the girl.

The Venomborne Terror felt very uncomfortable right now.
She's never allowed anyone to touch her in such a way, from behind at that.
Her survival instincts, honed through several lifetimes of extreme brutality, screamed at her to yank the girl off and cut her apart.
Rosie," Orianna said carefully, one brow lifting.
"I am not sure that is a safe spot.
Why don't you come over to me?"
Rosie patted Black Fang's head, completely at ease.
"No need.
Miss Black Fang is a very nice, friendly ancient lady!"

Still.
Quiet.
The look of a predator deciding how much effort a kill required.
